      "type": "suggestion",
      "kind": "approach",
      "text": "Avoid adding an output parameter by having SignMuSig2 update sigdata directly",

      "kind": "scope",
      "text": "If adopting achow101's restructure, consider key deduplication in make_keypath_sig and add a key-path test case to rpc_psbt.py",
      "quote": "And a key-path case in `rpc_psbt.py` would then belong in this PR, since its behaviour changes.",
      "clears_with": "answer",

    }
  ],
  "notes": "fametrano tested the script-path fix, confirming it fixes the issue, and noted the side-effects on key-path signing and testing if achow101's restructure suggestion is implemented."
}
